decisions.etienne_Aishihik: Confirm which of Sekulmun, Aishihik and Canyon lakes the storage represents, and whether release includes every outlet/diversion; obtain capacity on that same boundary.
decisions.etienne_Baskatong: Verify Mercier/Baskatong identity and total/active storage coordinate, then supply time-varying inflow and an explicit release prior or observations.
decisions.etienne_Carry_Falls: Verify station identity, all-outlet release coverage and physical capacity; obtain time-varying inflow before the fixed-storage-fraction flow-only route.
decisions.etienne_Corra_Linn: Verify Kootenay/Corra Linn identity and whether recorded flow is powerplant-only or total lake outflow; supply inflow and compatible capacity.
decisions.etienne_Dozois: Confirm storage datum/definition and catalog identity, then obtain inflow and declare a release prior; preserve declared missing-value interpretation.
decisions.etienne_Duncan: Verify Duncan dam capacity and total/active storage definition; supply time-varying inflow and an explicit release prior.
decisions.etienne_Hugh_Keenleyside: Completed conditional sensitivity profile; retain original source gate: Reconcile archived storage with live versus total Arrow Lakes storage and confirm total outlet discharge and storage/flow timing.
decisions.etienne_Kipawa: Establish dam/lake identity and storage coordinate before linking a GRAND ID; obtain inflow and a documented release prior.
decisions.etienne_Lake_Chelan: Keep the already converted m3/s field; verify total versus powerplant-only release, capacity and independent inflow forcing.
decisions.etienne_Lake_of_the_Woods: Identify the correct Lake of the Woods storage/control boundary; do not adopt the unrelated 17.5 million m3 name match. Supply inflow and a release prior.
decisions.etienne_Minidoka: Resolve active versus total storage and negative MIN storage, and establish whether discharge includes both canals as well as the Snake River; do not clip or offset records yet.
decisions.etienne_Namakan: Confirm the regulated lake-system boundary, datum and capacity; obtain inflow and a documented release prior.
decisions.etienne_Nechako: Resolve Ootsa/Kenney storage coordinate: archived values around 30 billion m3 exceed the 23.8 billion m3 catalog candidate; confirm diverted and river outlet components.
decisions.etienne_Rainy: Confirm Rainy Lake versus a different dam/system identity and storage datum; obtain inflow and an explicit release prior.
decisions.etienne_Revelstoke: Completed conditional sensitivity profile; retain original source gate: Verify capacity, total outflow and observation clock. Extend the 2018-2019 storage record, or use a separately labelled short-record experiment without claiming normal multi-regime assessment.
decisions.etienne_Seton: Resolve Seton storage capacity/datum and whether release includes canal/powerplant diversions and river outlet; preserve exceedances without clipping.
decisions.etienne_Waterbury: Confirm storage definition and capacity on the same datum; obtain inflow and an explicit release prior.
decisions.etienne_Winnebago: Establish the lake-system capacity/coordinate and all outlet components, including any connected-lake operations, before adopting the conditional net-flux route.
decisions.etienne_Winnipeg: Resolve whether 5-6 billion m3 archived storage is an active/offset coordinate rather than catalog total storage; confirm Jenpeg/system boundary, inflow and release prior.
decisions.etienne_Wrightsville: Retain the untimed arithmetic daily storage proxy label and original within-day ranges; verify measurement timing, datum/capacity, inflow and release prior.
